address: 212B/D48 Nguyen Trai Street, Cau Ong Lanh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 71014, Vietnam
bio: Spread over three floors, this medium-sized seafood restaurant is clean and well organised, with air-conditioning on the second floor. Shellfish takes centre stage, with plenty of fresh options on offer. The cooking is straightforward but effective, especially the garlic-butter sautéed and salt-grilled dishes, which allow the natural flavours to shine. Most items are priced on the menu, while premium seafood from the tanks is available at market price. Do remember to bring cash.
